decode_layout: Fixed 4-byte little-endian layout, no padding: offset 0..4 = n : u32 (LE). Bytes beyond offset 4 are ignored. Decode is total: if input.len() < 4 the harness returns an empty Vec instead of panicking. ENCODE: the u32 result written little-endian as 4 bytes. Note the original program's own `v[n as usize]` index panic for n >= 100 is preserved unguarded, as it is part of the benchmark's semantics.
entry_called: alloc(n: u32) -> u32 — the lifted body of the benchmark's #[jolt::provable] fn alloc (builds Vec::<u32> of 0..100, returns v[n as usize]), marked #[inline(never)] so it survives as an ELF symbol for --trace-fn
